# Agentic Inbox Response Desk

Agentic Inbox Response Desk is a SaaS workspace for agentic-inbox.

Website: https://agenticinboxdesk.space/
Docs pattern reference: https://github.com/clauxel/MiroFish
Primary keyword: agentic-inbox
Type: SaaS
Default plan: team

Public boundary: docs-only repository; no production source code or secrets.
